ideas.idea: Add Organization/LocalBusiness JSON-LD to the home page
ideas.why: Contradicts the deliberate choice that having no JSON-LD is not a required fix.

ideas.idea: Add address, hours and directions as text on /visit, with LocalBusiness openingHoursSpecification markup
ideas.why: The page's description promises directions but its body has only one line of hours, so adding the details as text helps people and machines; the markup part is optional.

ideas.idea: Give each variety its own page, such as /varieties/ashmeads-kernel, and list them on the index
ideas.why: The page claims over forty varieties but names only two, so separate pages would give each variety its own address and content.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to the sitemap entries
ideas.why: This applies to almost any sitemap, has little effect, and the report itself hedges with 'might help'.

ideas.idea: Add openGraph title, description and image metadata
ideas.why: Accurate because no openGraph is set, but it is standard advice for any site and mainly affects link previews.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport and canonical to every page
ideas.why: The public pages already have canonicals, Next.js already supplies the viewport, and the account page is deliberately private, so the item is self-contradictory.

ideas.idea: Link between related pages, such as from varieties to visit
ideas.why: The pages have no in-content links to each other, so a contextual link on /varieties pointing to /visit is a small, concrete improvement.

ideas.idea: Make titles name the orchard and Herefordshire
ideas.why: The /varieties and /visit titles don't name the orchard or place, so adding them makes the pages clearer in results and tabs.
